'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 John Anderson LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
